messages.author: 651db60946af6cea
messages.subject: High 1000 permutation LOD cutoffs
parts:
Hello all,

This is a general question about inflated LOD cutoffs determined by 1000 permutations in CIM.

I understand that LOD cutoffs depend on the organism and chromosome number etc but I am trying to determine what might cause some of my traits to have LOD cutoffs >10 determined by N=1000 permutations. Maybe a LOD >10 isn't considered excessive? I also have QTL with marker LOD >10 but I have seen high LOD scores with both em and hk methods.

Best,
Sean

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: High 1000 permutation LOD cutoffs
parts:
I would look at the distribution of permutation results. In cases with surprisingly large LOD thresholds, you’ll often see that the distribution of LOD scores across permutations is multimodal. The second mode can be the result of outliers in the phenotype distribution, perhaps in combination with some regions of the genome having large gaps between markers.

karl
